J1.evidence: Arabic: وَزَعَمَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَنَّهَا أَفَادَتْ مَا لَمْ تُفِدْهُ «كُلُّهُمْ». EN reads: 'Some claimed that it conveys what «كُلُّهُمْ» did not convey' — the negation is present and correct; the reviewer's claim of 'did convey' does not match the actual EN text. Rest of EN (tawkīd thānin, ḥāl lā tawkīd, إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ in al-Baqara, 35) is faithful and the verse-29 merge is marked in a Translator's note.

J2.evidence: Claim is false: EN reads 'it conveys what «كُلُّهُمْ» did not convey', correctly rendering أَفَادَتْ مَا لَمْ تُفِدْهُ «كُلُّهُمْ»; negation preserved. Rest of EN matches the Arabic, and the 29/30 merge is in a marked Translator's note.
